expression.title:
Expression of Cooperative
Cultural Heritage
expression.description:
An expression of Cooperative Cultural Heritage is a distinctive practice, place, tradition,
institution, or system that embodies the values, identity, and legacy of cooperation.

recognition.title: Each heritage element is recognized because:
points: Embodies cooperative principles (democracy, fairness, solidarity, mutual support).
Holds cultural, social, or historical significance for a community or region.
Demonstrates continuity and innovation, connecting past traditions with present and future needs.

selection.title:
How will the cultural
expressions be selected?
selection.description:
The selection will follow clear and transparent standards to reflect the
diversity and richness of the global cooperative tradition.

identification.title: Identification Criteria
identification.description:
A cultural expression should meet most or all of the following
fundamental criteria

criteria.title: Rooted in cooperative principles
criteria.description: Embodies core cooperative values: democracy, equality, equity, solidarity, and self-help. Demonstrates shared ownership or governance.

criteria.title: Cultural and social significance
criteria.description: Holds importance for a community's identity, memory, or continuity. Contributes to social cohesion, mutual support, or cultural expression.

criteria.title: Historical or heritage value
criteria.description: Represents milestones in cooperative development. Preserves stories, traditions, or knowledge tied to cooperative evolution.

criteria.title: Transmission across generations
criteria.description: Actively practiced, preserved, or interpreted by communities. Provides educational value, inspiring younger generations.

criteria.title: Continuity and innovation
criteria.description: Demonstrates adaptation of cooperative practices to changing contexts. Balances preservation with creativity and renewal.

criteria.title: Community ownership and participation
criteria.description: Named and governed with active member involvement. Reflects collective consent and participation in its recognition.
